referenceFunction.generalComment: This process can only be used together with the process "biogas, mix, at agricultural co-fermentation, covered" because bio waste is not treated in agricultural biogas plants alone but only together with liquid manure. This process has been generated to give the possibility to model co-fermentation with different inputs. The multioutput-process "bio waste, to agriculture co-fermentation, covered" delivers the co-products "biogas", "application of digested matter" and the service "disposal of bio waste". The functional unit refers to 1 kg fresh matter of vegetable and organic waste and catering waste. The allocation is based on economic criteria. ; UUID: 9e5d91a4-e352-35e9-be9b-8c3867862d72

technology.text: To reduce methane emission the stock container is covered, to reduce NH3 emissions the digested matter will be spread with a trail hose.
